node.statement: A UCP map is completely contractive: for every n put Psi=id_{M_n} tensor Phi. Complete positivity makes id_{M_2} tensor Psi positive; applying it to the positive block matrix [[X^*X,X^*],[X,I]] and taking the Schur complement gives Psi(X)^*Psi(X)<=Psi(X^*X). Positivity and unitality give 0<=Psi(X^*X)<=||X||^2 I, hence ||Psi(X)||<=||X||. Therefore ||Phi||_cb<=1.
